results.content:
Flipcorder is a 1991 camcorder for your iPhone. You film little moments through the day, each one a “flip” (20 seconds by default), and they all land on that day’s dated tape. There’s no editing, so the chatter, the pauses and the fumble for the stop button stay in. Tonight, you play back one raw home movie in a warm VHS or crisp MiniDV look, date stamp and all.

I really wanted a way to capture those moments and keep authentic video alive - I feel we have lost so much chasing perfection for social media, that the messiness of a camcorder is appealing and comforting. Home movies can be for anyone, and Flipcorder is for those people. [...] Flipcorder

results.title: Flipcorder: a retro camcorder for iPhone | Lotus Apps
results.content:
The day tape

## Real tapes ran out. That was the charm.

A camcorder cassette held only so much, so you filmed the moments that mattered. Flipcorder keeps that limit, gently: short flips on purpose, one tape a day, and a fresh tape every midnight.

 0:20

  ### Flips, not footage.

  Twenty seconds is enough to catch the moment and get back to it. Want a longer take? Set Flip length to No limit in the camcorder’s settings. It’s the same app at the same price, with nothing to unlock.
 30:00

  ### A 30-minute tape every day.

  Like a real cassette, today’s tape holds 30 minutes, and the camcorder shows how much is left. When it’s full, a fresh one loads at midnight. A flip that runs into the end is cut short and saved, never lost.
 OFF

  ### Gentle reminders, if you want them. [...] ### Watch it like it’s 1991.

A tape playing: PLAY 0:00:01 over a sunset sea, with the cassette labelled Sun, Oct 4, 2 flips, 0:00:27 in the player below, and its eject, pause, look, delete, FLIP and TAPE, save and share keys.

Tonight, tap the day’s spine and the tape drops into the player. Its flips play back to back, like an old home video, tracking wobble and all.

### Save it your way.

The Save or Share menu: Camcorder look, just like the viewfinder, or Original (clean HD), the footage without any effects, with Cancel, Share and Save keys.

Save the whole tape to Photos as one movie that opens on a title card, in the camcorder look or as the clean HD original. Then share it straight from the camcorder.

# Flipcorder brings retro camcorder footage to your iPhone

Flipcorder, a new indie app, lets iPhone users record retro-style camcorder footage, with optimization for the iPhone Duo and compatibility with other models.
The app records footage in 20-second segments onto a single virtual tape holding up to 30 minutes, encouraging unedited capture of small moments via a red record button. It offers VHS and MiniDV styles, plus a high-quality mode with the cassette compilation.
Flipcorder is available for a one-time $4.99 purchase on the App Store for iPhones running iOS 26 or later, with no in-app purchases or ads.
